schema_source.note: Five of the twenty-two upstream scenarios need this server. When it is absent those five stay unobserved with the reason `vlei_unavailable`.

startup_command: started outside this repository; a local KERIA has no compose file to hash
timeout_policy: the production transport's default deadline covers each exchange; no scenario sleeps, and every wait polls a condition
note: A `local` run cannot close PORTING.md §10's `Target KERIA integration version` row: that row asks for an image digest, and a KERIA on the host has no image. What this records is the strongest identity available — the document the agent serves about itself — which also answers §10:9799's residual, whose text claims that document `carries no version`.
